name: NTR: Never Truly Yours
source:
Leonard Royce has just graduated from high school and started university, hoping for a fresh and clean beginning. He lives with his stepmother and stepsisters, trying to find his place his new academic life. For now, everything seems to be going well. A new environment, new opportunities, and a chance to finally become someone stronger, more confident — someone different from who he used to be.

But life rarely follows the plans we make.

After all… life is what happens while you are busy making plans.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/d3sirestudio/about]Patreon[/url]]
